title: Saturday strength + 12-3-30
subtitle: ~60 min · Lifetime Reston · 12-3-30 first, then machines, one at a time
feeling: Rested after a light week. Hamstring feels a little off (not painful). Want a real workout, then I need to study.
note: No supersets: finish all 3 sets on one machine, then move to the next. Rest about 60-75 sec between sets and finish each set with 2 reps left. Skip anything that tugs the hamstring. On the incline, drop to 8-10% if the back of the leg complains.

sections.label: Cardio first · listen to your interview prep

12-3-30: 12% incline, 3 mph (ease to 8-10% if hamstring objects)
